newsitem.title: USA: FAA to present new air safety plan - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: FAA to present new air safety plan - WSJ.

text.p: The Federal Aviation Administration will announce a new air safety plan today that would include information on individual airlines to be posted on the Internet, the Wall Street Journal said Wednesday.
Under the plan, the FAA would provide accident data and other reports including federal enforcement actions against individual airlines, the paper said.
The FAA is also expected to present plans to reclassify the ways it defines accidents and incidents. The report said the plan would stop short of ranking carriers based on safety records.
A news conference is scheduled today in Washington at 1630 EDT to discuss safety reform measures at the FAA, but it was not immediately clear if the plan would be presented at the conference.
